mapper.sql: k.id,k.key_code,k.name,k.secret_hash,k.key_prefix,k.credential_type AS credentialType,k.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, owner.status AS ownerUserStatus,p.status AS principalStatus,p.external_instance_id AS externalInstanceId,p.external_subject_id AS externalSubjectId, k.knowledge_base_id,k.principal_id AS principalId, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_principal_kb_grant g WHERE g.principal_id=k.principal_id AND g.status='ACTIVE' AND (g.expires_at IS NULL OR g.expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) AS grantedKnowledgeBaseCount, b.name AS knowledge_base_name,k.scopes,k.rate_limit_per_minute,k.status,k.expires_at,k.last_used_at, p.name AS principalName,p.principal_type AS principalType, k.created_by,u.display_name AS created_by_name,k.created_time,k.updated_time,k.allowed_origins, COALESCE(mp.namespace_code,k.memory_namespace) AS memoryNamespace,COALESCE(mp.agent_code,k.memory_agent_code) AS memoryAgentCode, k.memory_read_enabled AS memoryReadEnabled,k.memory_write_enabled AS memoryWriteEnabled, CAST(k.permission_tags AS CHAR) AS permissionTags
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_api_key k LEFT JOIN t_knowledge_base b ON b.id=k.knowledge_base_id LEFT JOIN t_principal p ON p.id=k.principal_id LEFT JOIN t_principal_memory_profile mp ON mp.principal_id=k.principal_id AND mp.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN t_user owner ON owner.id=k.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id=k.created_by ORDER BY k.created_time DESC

SELECT FROM t_api_key k LEFT JOIN t_knowledge_base b ON b.id=k.knowledge_base_id LEFT JOIN t_principal p ON p.id=k.principal_id LEFT JOIN t_principal_memory_profile mp ON mp.principal_id=k.principal_id AND mp.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN t_user owner ON owner.id=k.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id=k.created_by WHERE k.id=#{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM t_api_key k LEFT JOIN t_knowledge_base b ON b.id=k.knowledge_base_id LEFT JOIN t_principal p ON p.id=k.principal_id LEFT JOIN t_principal_memory_profile mp ON mp.principal_id=k.principal_id AND mp.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN t_user owner ON owner.id=k.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id=k.created_by WHERE k.secret_hash=#{secretHash} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_principal WHERE id=#{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_principal WHERE owner_user_id=#{userId} AND principal_type='USER' LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_user WHERE id=#{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_principal SET owner_user_id=#{userId} WHERE id=#{principalId} AND principal_type='USER' AND owner_user_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_api_key k LEFT JOIN t_knowledge_base b ON b.id=k.knowledge_base_id LEFT JOIN t_principal p ON p.id=k.principal_id LEFT JOIN t_principal_memory_profile mp ON mp.principal_id=k.principal_id AND mp.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN t_user owner ON owner.id=k.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id=k.created_by WHERE k.owner_user_id=#{userId} AND k.credential_type='USER_PAT' ORDER BY k.created_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_api_key SET status='REVOKED' WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_user_id=#{userId} AND credential_type='USER_PAT' AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE t_api_key SET scopes=#{scopes} WHERE id=#{id} AND credential_type='USER_PAT'
mapper.select: SELECT p.id,p.principal_code AS principalCode,p.principal_type AS principalType,p.name,p.status,p.created_by AS createdBy, p.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId,p.external_instance_id AS externalInstanceId,p.external_subject_id AS externalSubjectId FROM t_external_identity_binding b JOIN t_principal p ON p.id=b.principal_id WHERE b.provider=#{provider} AND b.provider_instance_id=#{instanceId} AND b.external_user_id=#{externalUserId} AND b.status='ACTIVE' AND p.status='ACTIVE' AND p.principal_type='USER' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_external_identity_binding SET status=#{status}, updated_by=#{operatorId},reason=IFNULL(#{reason},reason) WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE t_external_identity_binding SET status='REVOKED',revoked_by=#{operatorId},revoked_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{operatorId},reason=#{reason} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_octop_assertion_jti WHERE expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT principal_id AS principalId,namespace_code AS namespace, agent_code AS agentCode,status FROM t_principal_memory_profile WHERE principal_id=#{principalId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_principal_memory_profile(principal_id,namespace_code,agent_code,status,created_by) VALUES(#{principalId},#{namespace},#{agentCode},'ACTIVE',#{operatorId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE namespace_code=VALUES(namespace_code),agent_code=VALUES(agent_code),status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT p.id,p.principal_code AS principalCode,p.name,p.status, p.principal_type AS principalType, COUNT(DISTINCT k.id) AS keyCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN g.status='ACTIVE' AND (g.expires_at IS NULL OR g.expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) THEN g.id END) AS activeGrantCount, p.created_time AS createdTime FROM t_principal p LEFT JOIN t_api_key k ON k.principal_id=p.id LEFT JOIN t_principal_kb_grant g ON g.principal_id=p.id GROUP BY p.id,p.principal_code,p.principal_type,p.name,p.status,p.created_time ORDER BY p.created_time DESC,p.id DESC

SELECT p.id,p.principal_code AS principalCode,p.principal_type AS principalType,p.name,p.status,p.created_by AS createdBy FROM t_principal_identity_link l JOIN t_principal p ON p.id=l.principal_id WHERE l.issuer=#{issuer} AND l.subject=#{subject} AND l.status='ACTIVE' AND p.status='ACTIVE' AND p.principal_type='USER' LIMIT 1

SELECT id,principal_id AS principalId,issuer,subject,status,created_by AS createdBy,created_time AS createdTime, revoked_by AS revokedBy,revoked_time AS revokedTime FROM t_principal_identity_link principal_id=#{principalId} ORDER BY created_time DESC,id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_principal_identity_link SET status='REVOKED',revoked_by=#{operatorId},revoked_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_principal_kb_grant(principal_id,knowledge_base_id,status,reason,created_by,expires_at,permission_tags) SELECT #{targetPrincipalId},knowledge_base_id,'ACTIVE',reason,#{createdBy},expires_at,permission_tags FROM t_principal_kb_grant WHERE principal_id=#{sourcePrincipalId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(permission_tags AS CHAR) FROM t_principal_kb_grant WHERE principal_id=#{principalId} AND knowledge_base_id=#{knowledgeBaseId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_knowledge_base WHERE id=#{knowledgeBaseId}
SELECT knowledge_base_id FROM t_principal_kb_grant WHERE principal_id=#{principalId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY knowledge_base_id

SELECT knowledge_base_id AS knowledgeBaseId,expires_at AS expiresAt, reason,status,created_time AS createdTime,CAST(permission_tags AS CHAR) AS permissionTagsJson FROM t_principal_kb_grant WHERE principal_id=#{principalId} ORDER BY knowledge_base_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_api_key SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE t_api_key SET last_used_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_api_call_audit WHERE channel=#{channel} ORDER BY created_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM t_api_call_audit WHERE trace_id=#{traceId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_api_call_audit ORDER BY created_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errorCount, AVG(duration_ms) avgDurationMs,MAX(duration_ms) maxDurationMs FROM t_api_call_audit WHERE created_time >= #{since}
SELECT duration_ms FROM t_api_call_audit WHERE created_time >= #{since} ORDER BY duration_ms ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT channel,SUM(CASE WHEN status_code < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errorCount FROM t_api_call_audit WHERE created_time >= #{since} GROUP BY channel
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_api_key WHERE status='ACTIVE'
SELECT * FROM t_embed_token_revocation WHERE jti=#{jti} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_embed_token_revocation ORDER BY revoked_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT token_jti jti,MAX(key_id) keyId,MAX(key_code) keyCode, MAX(knowledge_base_id) knowledgeBaseId,MAX(origin) origin,COUNT(*) calls, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errors,MAX(created_time) lastCallTime, MIN(created_time) firstCallTime FROM t_api_call_audit WHERE token_jti IS NOT NULL AND token_jti <> '' AND created_time >= #{since} GROUP BY token_jti ORDER BY lastCallTime DESC LIMIT #{limit}
